verdict.rationale: The config docs show some font tuning through the character offset setting, which adjusts line spacing (y) and letter spacing (x). A community user calls the font rendering great. However, another community comment says ligature support has long been missing, with no sign it will arrive, and the evidence says nothing about fallback fonts. Missing for 10: ligature support (the community reports it absent), fallback font configuration, and broader font tuning such as family, size, style or glyph offsets.
